main_text.p: פעע ܦܥܥ Syr. Vulnerare, Idem quod פּיַע Hebr. mutato ɣ in ע.Part.plur. ܥܥܥ Vulnerati, Act.19 16. Deinde Pahel geminat. ܦܥܥ Ch. Lucere, Splendere, Job.10.22.
פער Ch. Aperire, Solvere, Laxare ventrem: ולמפער ונרמיהוןדפעור Et laxare se coram Pehor, Num. 25.1.in Jon. Solebant enim ignominiae causâ se coram illo idolo laxare, unde etiam nomen obtinuit.
ܦܥܥ Syr. Cavernae, Cum Aff. ܣܦܥܥܝܐ Et in cavernis terrae, ad Heb.11.38.
פפר ܦܝܦܝܪܐ Ch. Vasa texta instar corbium, Deuter. 26.3.in Targ. Jonath. Cophini papyracei.
פצא Ch. Aperire, ut Hebr. Jobi 35.16: Item Liberare, eripere, eruere. Pahel פצי Chald. & Syr. Idem. Aph. אפצי Idem. Ithpeh. אתפצי, vel Ithpah. אתפצי Liberari, eripi, eripere se.
ܦܝܬܐ פיתא Ch. Sors. Idem quod פיסא, mutatis ם & ץ: Item Liberatio, ereptio, Deut.4.34.in Jon.
פצר פציר פציר& פצירא Ch. Fovea, fossa, lacuna; Rivus, Alveus aquarum. Plur. פצירין & פצירא; Fossae, Rivi: Item Firmitates, Validitates, Jobi 40.13.&41.6.
פצח Hebr. Fragorem, Sonum edere, Personare. Hinc Syr. Ethpehal Imper. ܐܬܦܨܚ Erumpe, vel Exulta, ad Gal.4.27.

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek-style and Syriac words are reproduced from the scan as closely as legible; the Syriac script at the end of the last entry and several vowel-pointed Hebrew forms are uncertain. Hebrew and Syriac marks in the original are reproduced approximately.
